name: validate_document
description: Preflight read-only OOXML audit for a session: runs the same validator gate save_document enforces, before anything is written. Detects schema violations while they are still cheap to fix. Strictly read-only: zero session mutation (revision and dirty flag untouched), zero disk writes, zero history commits. Returns {ok:true,sessionId,revision,dirty,validation:{valid,errorCount,errors}} where errors carry description + xPath (first 10, same shape as the save-blocked envelope). The verdict is on the document as a save would write it (children put in schema order first); when that save would repair something the result also carries pendingNormalizations (a list of repairs, absent when none), so a valid verdict is not mistaken for "valid exactly as it stands". Use before save_document when the package may be non-conforming; save_document re-gates before writing. Example {"sessionId":"sess_abc"} -> {"ok":true,"validation":{"valid":true,"errorCount":0,"errors":[]}}. IDs are session-scoped: valid only in the issuing session, must not be stored across sessions. ECMA-376 essentials: colors are hex without # (e.g. 4F46E5, never #4F46E5); font sizes are half-points in w:sz (e.g. 28 = 14pt, 22 = 11pt); spacing/margins/cellMar use twips dxa (twentieths of a point, e.g. 240 = 12pt, 180 = 9pt); borders use eighths-of-a-point sz (e.g. 32 = 4pt left accent). Workflow: open_document -> inspect_document -> search_content -> execute_batch -> save_document -> close_document. Always inspect first, batch second, save third. Single edit = 1-item batch. Never call twice when once suffices.
